title.zh: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
title.en: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes

current_state.zh: MSCI finalized rules that would remove Strategy, Metaplanet and other investment-holding companies from its global equity indexes, with the affected list due Nov. 11 and Strategy potentially facing about $2.8 billion in index-driven stock outflows.
current_state.en: MSCI finalized rules that would remove Strategy, Metaplanet and other investment-holding companies from its global equity indexes, with the affected list due Nov. 11 and Strategy potentially facing about $2.8 billion in index-driven stock outflows.
